items.title: This bar works
items.do: Read this test, click **Pass**. Then open **List**, click **Show** on another test, and press Shift+K twice.
items.expect: Pass moves to the next open test; Show brings that test here; Shift+K hides the bar and shows it again. The bar can be dragged by its top line and folded (the arrow).

items.title: A Fail keeps a note and the console errors
items.do: On any test, click **Fail**, type a note, Save. Open List, click **Copy report**, paste it somewhere.
items.expect: The report has a FAIL line with your note (and "console:" lines if Foundry logged errors since that test was shown). Click Fail again on that test: it opens again. Clear it before you go on.

items.title: Update from the compendium
items.do: Open the world as the GM after the update. When asked, accept **Update from the compendium**.
items.expect: The PCs' cards are refreshed (Judge on a Paladin ends with "Multiple Paladins can Judge the same creature: it is Judged by each of them."). Nothing you added to a sheet by hand is removed.

items.title: NPCs from the compendium again
items.do: Delete the NPCs on the scene and drag the Goblin Sneak, Orc Warrior, Grave Wisp and Ogre Chieftain in again from the compendium.
items.expect: Their melee cards read "Distance: Reach (1)" (the Ogre: its own Reach), and the cards with a push write "Pushed N" in Tiers 2 and 3.

items.title: What the compendiums hold
items.do: Open the compendiums.
items.expect: Actions: the Basic Actions, the Paladin's, the Archer's and four Weapon Techniques (no "old cards", Talents or Testing folders). Weapons: Arming Sword, Longsword, Dagger, Hunting Bow, Recurve Bow and the armors. NPCs: the four above. PCs: Durgan holds an Arming Sword; Sylwen and Kaela are the Archers.

items.title: A new Paladin's levels
items.do: Make a new character, drop the Paladin class from the compendium, open the class window.
items.expect: Level 1: Judge and Smite granted; Binding Light or Lay On Hands; Shield of Faith or Rebuke; an Art (three); Armor of Faith or Roving Judgment. Level 2: Kindled Wrath, the three Encounter Picks, Weight of Judgment or Tireless Vigil. Level 3: the two Arts you don't have, Reckoning or Hallowed Stance.

items.title: A new Archer's levels
items.do: Make a new character, drop the Archer class, open the class window.
items.expect: Level 1 offers Quick Shots or Strafe, Slip Away or Snap Shot, an Art, Lean and Loose or Blade and Bow (Shifting Aim and Darting Blade granted); Light Armor Training. Shifting Aim's bow choice opens the system's pick window and gives Mastery 5 with that bow.

items.title: Stage 0 on the sheet
items.do: Open a level 1 to 3 character's sheet and its Build tab; take a test character to level 4.
items.expect: The sheet says Stage 0. The Build tab's "Next levels" at level 3 reads "Stage 1: Stage Talent · ... · Rally +1 · +1 to one Modifier" with no Health part (the steps aren't written yet). At level 4 the class window asks which Modifier takes the +1. The Talent slots say they stay empty and don't block "complete".

items.title: The Action card in the book's look
items.do: Open Smite, Judge and Commandment on a Paladin's Actions tab, in the dark and the light interface.
items.expect: Smite: the Flavor in italic, the traits line, Distance and Target, Smite dice, Attack, Tier 1 / 2 / 3, Special, then Use. Judge: two blocks (0 AP, 1 AP) each with its Use. Commandment: three Mode blocks, Kneel with its own Save. Both themes readable.

items.title: The Frequency word on Reactions only
items.do: Look at a Paladin's Basic Actions and Reactions on the sheet.
items.expect: A Basic Action's box shows only its cost ("1 AP"); a Reaction's shows its Frequency and cost ("Turn · 1R").

items.title: Rally Points editable by the player
items.do: As a player, change your character's Rally Points on the sheet.
items.expect: It saves, and a short system line in the chat says the change.

items.title: An item sheet's traits
items.do: Open a weapon's and an Action's item sheet.
items.expect: The traits are the card's plain words (no colored chips), and a sheet keeps its own light look inside a dark interface where it has one.

items.title: The NPC sheet's Level
items.do: On an NPC sheet, change its Level, then click its image.
items.expect: The Level saves; the image picker opens.

items.title: The Class Levels Editor saves a section's title
items.do: Open a class's Levels Editor, rename a section, save, open it again.
items.expect: The new title is kept.

items.title: The NPC Builder tab
items.do: Open the Orc Warrior's Builder tab; click the Striker preset on a copy.
items.expect: Health 60 (Vigor 36, Resolve 24), AD 13, WD 11, CV 100; the Damage row "25/AP" for a Standard; the turn-budget table; Best turn about 93 of 100 with no warning. Striker sets High damage, High Vigor, Low Resolve, Low AD, Low Weapon Modifier, CV unchanged.

items.title: A class without levels
items.do: Drop a class item with no levels on a character.
items.expect: A warning to give it levels first (no Attribute window).

items.title: Three Goblins on one Initiative roll
items.do: Put three Goblin Sneaks in a combat and roll Initiative from the Initiative window.
items.expect: One roll, the same Initiative for the three (the card says "×3"), each with its own turn. A Goblin Sneak has 3 AP and no Reaction AP.

items.title: Momentum and Escalation at the start
items.do: Before starting, set Momentum to 2 (left-click +1, right-click −1 on the strip). Start the combat; go to round 2.
items.expect: The strip reads "Preparing the encounter · Momentum 2", then "Round 1 · Momentum 2"; every PC starts at Escalation 3 (an Elite at 1). Round 2 raises everyone by 1, up to 6 (six pips on the sheet and the HUD).

items.title: Judge at the start of an encounter
items.do: Start a combat with Aveline and Durgan in it.
items.expect: Each Paladin's player is reminded to Judge (target it and use Judge, 0 AP). Both can Judge the same Orc: its token shows both rings, and it counts as Profane for each of them.

groups.name: Your turn: Actions and the roll dialog

items.title: The roll dialog follows the card
items.do: Open the roll dialog of Smite, Lay On Hands and Rebuke.
items.expect: Smite: "Smite dice" above Attack, then Tier 1 to 3, then Special. Lay On Hands: Setup above the Tiers. Rebuke: Trigger at the top. A label reads "Requirement". Judge's dialog has no "Attack: ..." line (it has no roll).

items.title: Smite by Escalation and the Reaction AP die
items.do: At Escalation 3, Smite the Judged enemy; tick "Reaction AP: 1 more Smite die" in the roll dialog. Then Smite an enemy that isn't Judged.
items.expect: Against the Judged one: d8s (Tier 2: 3d8! Holy with the weapon), 4 dice with the tick and the Reaction AP spent. Against the other: d6s.

items.title: The hands' Banes
items.do: Strike with a weapon in the off hand; then with a bow while the other hand holds a Dagger; then with a bow and the other hand free.
items.expect: Off hand: 2 Banes in the roll dialog (a Dagger: 1); the bow with a Dagger in the other hand: 3 Banes; the bow with a free hand: none.

items.title: A ranged shot while Engaged
items.do: With an Archer adjacent to an enemy, use a [Ranged] Action.
items.expect: The roll dialog's chip reads "You are Engaged (Doomed)" and the roll is Doomed.

items.title: Shifting Aim and Blade and Bow
items.do: On Sylwen's turn, shoot from where you started; Evade a square and shoot; shoot again without moving. At Escalation 2 with Blade and Bow, use Darting Blade after a shot, twice.
items.expect: No Boon on the first shot; "Shifting Aim" (1 Field Boon) on the second; none on the third. Darting Blade gets 1 Boon the first time that turn, none the second.

items.title: Quick Shots and One More Arrow
items.do: Use Quick Shots at Tier 2 and Tier 3; at Escalation 6, make your turn's first Strike.
items.expect: Tier 2 deals the bow twice (2[W]), Tier 3 three times, then the Evade 2 button. At Escalation 6 the first Strike deals 1[W] more.

items.title: Wounding Shot and Lingering
items.do: Use Wounding Shot from where you started your turn; then move a square and try again. Land a Tier 2.
items.expect: From your square it rolls; after moving it is refused ("has left its square this turn"). Tier 2 applies "Lingering [V] 1 (Bo/In)"; at the end of the creature's turn its damage card says "Ends with Shake Off (1 AP)".

items.title: Exploding dice and Empowered
items.do: Roll Weapon Attacks until a die shows its top face. Give a PC Empowered and make two damaging Actions in its turn.
items.expect: A 6 on a d6 shows "6!", counts 5 and adds a new roll. The first damage card has an "Empowered 1d6!" line; the second has none.

items.title: An Art's Modes (Commandment)
items.do: Use Commandment from the sheet or the HUD; pick Kneel.
items.expect: A pick window asks Challenge / Courage / Kneel. Kneel rolls the target's Appeal Save; Tier 1 or 2 makes it Prone by itself.

items.title: Lantern of Faith
items.do: Use Kindle, then Glare on an enemy.
items.expect: Kindle lights you (Bright 3) until the encounter ends. Glare: an Instinct Save; on a failure the target is Half-Blinded until the end of its turn.

items.title: The HUD shows only usable Techniques
items.do: Select Durgan without the Mastery for Seizing Cut and open the HUD.
items.expect: Seizing Cut is not in the HUD (it shows once the Mastery unlocks it at 10). The HUD shows the Pow Defense.

items.title: The chat card follows the card
items.do: Use Smite, Rebuke (its Save card) and Judge.
items.expect: Smite: "Smite dice:" above the Tier stamp, "Special:" under it, before the Flavor. Rebuke's Save card: the Trigger above the Save and its Effect line (Hindered). Judge: "Judged:" and its Special once.

items.title: Click uses, right-click opens the rule
items.do: Click anywhere on a chat card's button (its icon, its word); right-click a button.
items.expect: A click uses it. A right-click opens its rule only (Foundry's message menu does not open).

items.title: Drag a condition from the chat
items.do: Drag a condition button (e.g. Prone) from a chat card onto a token. Try dragging a button from a sheet.
items.expect: The token gets the condition. A sheet's button doesn't drag.

items.title: The chat follows a growing card
items.do: Use an Action whose card grows (the damage written into it); scroll up a little in the chat, then click a damage stamp's link to its roll card.
items.expect: At the bottom, the chat follows the card as it grows. The jump to the roll card stays there (no snap back down).

items.title: Lines removed from the chat
items.do: Play a round: someone becomes Bloodied, someone uses a Reaction, someone goes Down, someone moves.
items.expect: No Bloodied / Strained, Reaction-use, "next damage reduced", "is Down" or movement lines. The stamp is stretched; the Critical's arrow sits over CRIT, the CRIT zone shows only on a Critical; Bloodied is in the Vigor red on dark.

items.title: An old chat card still works
items.do: In a chat card posted before the update, click Apply and retarget.
items.expect: It redraws with its old lines and Apply works.

items.title: A Tier's condition with no damage
items.do: Use Trip (2 AP) and land a Tier 2; use Trick Shots' Pin and Startle; use Thwart Cut and land a Tier 1.
items.expect: Each condition is applied by itself when its Tier lands (Prone, the Pin's and the Startle's, Pressed).

items.title: Reckoning
items.do: Use Reckoning on several enemies.
items.expect: Everyone is pushed; only those who rolled Tier 1 or 2 are Frightened (none is Frightened before its Save).

items.title: Seizing Cut's order
items.do: Land Seizing Cut at Tier 3 (both hands full first: Release is offered).
items.expect: Slid 1 first; Grabbed is a button to click after the Slide.

items.title: Thwart Cut's Pressed
items.do: Land Thwart Cut; the target makes its next Strike.
items.expect: The target is Pressed 1 (Tier 3: 2) until the end of its turn; its Strike shows the Pressure Banes.

items.title: Immobilized from a Tier
items.do: Immobilize a creature with a Tier; try to Break Free.
items.expect: Its DC is 11 + the user's Modifier (not 13).

items.title: Shake Off
items.do: Target a Lingering creature (or none, for yourself) and use Shake Off; get each Tier once.
items.expect: A Save card. Tier 3: it ends. Tier 2: the next end-of-turn card is halved ("Halved (Shake Off, Tier 2)"), then it ends. Tier 1: a line says it goes on.

items.title: A condition from a second creature
items.do: Make an Orc Frightened of Aveline for 3 rounds, then Frightened of Durgan for 1 round.
items.expect: It is Frightened of Durgan only, for 1 round. Made Frightened of Durgan again for 2 rounds: it keeps the longer duration.

items.title: A Reaction's condition
items.do: Rebuke an enemy that walks away; Snap Shot an enemy that walks up.
items.expect: Each is Hindered and its movement is cut to half from that moment.

items.title: Advance is one piece
items.do: In combat, Advance, move 2 of 5 squares, then use a Weapon Attack; drag again.
items.expect: The squares left are gone (the banner closes); dragging pays 1 AP for a new Advance.

items.title: One Interact inside an Advance
items.do: Advance, move 2, draw a weapon (or Interact); Interact a second time. Also Release mid-Advance.
items.expect: The first Interact pays 1 AP and the Advance's squares stay; the second ends it. Release (0 AP) doesn't end it.

items.title: Moving on someone else's turn
items.do: End a creature's turn with squares left; on the next creature's turn, drag the first one.
items.expect: It isn't free movement (refused, or the GM's normal drag). A Reaction's squares (e.g. Slip Away's) are free during that turn only.

items.title: Steadiness asked on the right screen
items.do: Push a player's creature with a GM creature; push a neutral creature with another neutral one.
items.expect: The pushed creature's player is asked (Apply / Ignore), not the GM. Two neutral creatures don't count as allies.

items.title: Trade Places
items.do: Use Hold the Line's Trade Places on an adjacent ally.
items.expect: The Swap button swaps both tokens at once; no Reaction is offered.

items.title: A Setup's movement
items.do: Use Lay On Hands on an ally 4 squares away; use Circling Shot.
items.expect: No "out of range" block; the Setup's button Advances (Circling Shot: Evade 1, then the shot, Tier 3's Evade 1). The Encounter Log writes it as one line ("Strafe (Setup: Advance 2)").

items.title: Judge's reduction is a question
items.do: The Judged enemy damages an ally within 5 squares of the Paladin. Answer "Not now"; then hit again the same round and answer "Reduce by N".
items.expect: The Paladin's player is asked on the bottom bar. "Not now" reduces nothing and keeps the round's use; the second hit asks again and is reduced. Unanswered for 2 minutes counts as "Not now".

items.title: Two Paladins Judge the same Orc
items.do: Aveline and Durgan both Judge one Orc; it damages an ally near both.
items.expect: Each Paladin is asked for their own reduction; Smite reads it as Profane for each.

items.title: Shield of Faith and its target
items.do: An enemy Strikes an ally within 5 of the Paladin; use Shield of Faith. Then try with the ally behind a wall from the Paladin.
items.expect: The damage is 1 + Pow less and the attacker is Taunted (1 round). Behind a wall: the Reactions message says it's blocked ("no Line of Effect to ...").

items.title: Rebuke and Snap Shot's Move back
items.do: An enemy within 3 walks away from the Paladin: use Rebuke; an enemy walks up to an Archer: use Snap Shot or Slip Away.
items.expect: The Reactions message offers each; Move back puts the enemy on the square before.

items.title: The HUD doesn't jump
items.do: Accept a Reaction from the Reactions message with the HUD open.
items.expect: The HUD keeps its place and size.

items.title: The Paladin's passives
items.do: At Escalation 2 use a [Divine] Reaction (Armor of Faith) or Judge's 1 AP (Roving Judgment); reach Escalation 4 and 6.
items.expect: Guard 1 + Pow, or Judge's 1 AP costs 0; at 4, two Reaction AP (Tireless Vigil); at 6, a [Divine] Action's card shows "Setup: You Advance 3" (Hallowed Stance).

items.title: Creatures in an area give no Cover
items.do: The Ogre uses Ground Slam on several creatures in a row.
items.expect: No creature gets Cover from another inside the area (walls still give it). The Ogre's allies in it are hit too.

items.title: The hover card over an area
items.do: Hover a placed area (Covering Fire, Consecrated Ground).
items.expect: A small card follows the mouse: its name and what it does inside.

items.title: Consecrated Ground and Word of Radiance
items.do: Place Consecrated Ground; walk an enemy in; start an ally's turn inside. Use Word of Radiance on enemies with one Judged.
items.expect: Enemies pay double in it; the ally gains Guard equal to your Power Modifier (a line). Word of Radiance: Appeal Saves, d8s against the Judged one, Pushes 3 / 2 / 1.

items.title: Covering Fire, Volley, Spotter
items.do: Place Covering Fire and walk an enemy in; use Volley on a 3 Burst; Call Out a creature in Dim light.
items.expect: The enemy takes [V] 2 + Weapon Modifier and pays double; Volley makes Prone on a Critical; your allies see the called-out creature Clear for 1 round.

items.title: Dim and Bright light on a roll
items.do: Attack with you and the enemy both in Dim light; you in Bright and the enemy in Dim; the enemy in Bright and you in Dim.
items.expect: Both Dim: 1 Field Bane, no Boon. You Bright, it Dim: 1 Field Bane, no Boon. It Bright, you Dim: 1 Field Boon.

items.title: Clear Lines and Opening Shot
items.do: At Escalation 4, shoot past an ally at an enemy Engaged with another ally; land a Tier 3.
items.expect: No Cover from your ally and no Field Bane; the Tier 3 line names your allies who threaten the target.

items.title: Momentum at the end
items.do: End an encounter (Overcome, then another one Retreat); a PC goes Down; two PCs Sleep the same night.
items.expect: The window asks Overcome / Retreat / Neither (Overcome 3, Retreat 0); a Down: −1; the first Sleep −1, the second nothing.

items.title: Mastery at the end of an encounter
items.do: End an Overcome encounter in which characters made Strikes; answer "Normal or harder".
items.expect: Each character who made a Strike gains 1 Mastery (several weapons: you pick); a chat line says so. The Mastery tab shows 10 / 20 / 30 / 45 / 60.

items.title: Thrill of the Kill and Kindled Wrath
items.do: An enemy the Archer damaged goes Down; an ally of the Paladin becomes Bloodied.
items.expect: The Archer's Escalation +1; the Paladin's Escalation +1 (once).

items.title: Swap on a Rest
items.do: Complete a Rest as a player and open the Build tab.
items.expect: "Swap on a Rest" shows (gone when an encounter starts); it asks the level, then the class window with that level's choices; the Attribute buttons are locked unless the optional world setting is on.

items.title: Damage to allies and numbered names
items.do: In a fight with two Goblin Sneaks, an area hits an ally and the user itself; open the Encounter Log.
items.expect: The damage table has a "To allies" column (damage to itself counts there); the Goblins are "Goblin Sneak 1" and "Goblin Sneak 2" in the window and in the copied text.

items.title: A struck line's reason
items.do: Hover a struck line in the Encounter Log.
items.expect: Its reason shows (one of the few hovers left).

items.title: Every question is a pick window
items.do: Meet a few of these: a Split Action's mode, a Strike out of your turn, a fourth Strike, Shift+E, the GM's "movement left", swap initiative, not enough AP, End Combat with a creature Dying, an Action with both hands full, Regrip, Reload, waking an Unconscious creature.
items.expect: Each opens in the class window's style (no Foundry dialog) and Cancel closes it doing nothing.

items.title: The forms
items.do: Open the Senses editor, the Encounter Log's Edit line and Add a note, an area placed by hand, Recovery, Generate Weapon.
items.expect: Each is a pick window; Save keeps what you typed; Generate Weapon's preview follows the type.
